vs_old_mass_budget.note: mass_budget.json (pre-procurement): batteries 2 x 100 g, printed 120 g, wiring 45 g; now 2 x 151 g batteries, printed parts from CAD volumes, wiring from routed lengths

assumptions: printed parts: H2S slicer grams of the v6 CAD (cad/slices/grams.json, Generic PLA 0.20 mm); PETG (1.27) would add 2 %
fan 77.0 g (cad/flight_params FAN_ID ARESWEI_HDS001); fan113 variant scales the fan parts to 113 g
printed parts use H2S slicer grams only when cad/slices/grams.json is newer than cad/build/build.json; otherwise CAD volume x 1.24 g/cm3 x 0.851 print fraction (solid volume would be 1/0.851 heavier)
wire lengths are routing estimates; connector, solder and strap masses are estimates
nothing in the pack is in hand or weighed
missing_or_assumed_vs_robot_now: the duck itself (960.45 g) is the battery-20261104 component estimate, never weighed; its backpack, saddle, A7Z and camera lead are estimates in that manifest
the pack is not built; the CAD is still being edited (cad/ is read at run time)
no tray-to-wing screws listed in cad/build/screws.json yet (about 4 x M2, 1.3 g, not counted)
MTF-01 and FC-to-A7Z cable lengths not known
